summary: This change adds two jobs to the promotion workflow. The first re-runs the idempotent exe.dev template step for the version being promoted, before production deploys. The second removes every `halo-exe-<version>` template older than the new production version, after the deploy succeeds. The filter is a pure function, `staleExeTemplates`, with a small command-line wrapper. Promotions must be strictly newer than production, and staging always runs a version at least as new as production, so cleanup never removes a template that either stack still uses. The durable tests check the filter (numeric version comparison, keeping the equal and newer versions, ignoring workspace and other names) and the command-line parsing and usage error. Every changed line is covered and both test runs pass, so the change is ready.
